about.title: Your textile connection in Türkiye
about.lead: Pamukkale Global is a textile sourcing brand based in Denizli, one of Türkiye’s leading textile manufacturing hubs.
about.p1: We connect international buyers with suitable Turkish manufacturers for towels, bathrobes, bedding, hospitality textiles and fabrics.
about.p2: Our approach is simple: understand what our clients need, identify the right production solution and facilitate clear communication throughout the sourcing process.
about.p3: With direct access to Denizli’s textile manufacturing network and communication in English, Spanish, German and Russian, we aim to make sourcing from Türkiye easier, more transparent and more efficient for international buyers.
about.mission: To build reliable connections between international buyers and Turkish textile manufacturers through clear communication, local market knowledge and flexible sourcing solutions.
